answer: Price attestation by exposure. An endorser stakes a slice of the reward it would unlock in a ferrous escrow, slashed if that work is convicted. Honest endorsing costs little since real work rarely overturns; a farm whose aliases rubber-stamp each other pays that exposure per manufactured endorsement. The wharf ledger lists endorsers' funding roots; same-root endorsers collapse to one vote. Moving a high verdict needs proportional capital across uncorrelated endorsers an operator cannot fabricate. The garden of honest review stays cheap; cost scales with stake at risk.
